purpose: Teach: 前置き/受け取ら/訊い/知らず/さらっ/今時/騒ぐ/めくっ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お話の前置きが長くなりごめんね
lines.en: Sho, sorry the preamble to that story got a bit long.
lines.style: Gentle apology, warm and slightly self-deprecating. Soft opening. The tone of a mother checking in with herself, not him. Pace is unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんから手紙、受け取らせてもらったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa let me receive a letter from him.
lines.style: Bright, careful precision in the delivery. Pride in having been trusted with something. Quick but not rushed. Eyes alight with the importance of what he's saying.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんに学校のこと、訊いてみてね
lines.en: Sho, why don't you ask Dad about what happened at school?
lines.style: Even, gentle prompt. Not a demand. The intonation of someone guiding rather than directing. Slight warmth underneath the practicality.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、知らずにお皿、割っちゃった
lines.en: Mom, I didn't mean to — I broke a plate.
lines.style: Quiet confession, braced for reaction. Small voice under the words. Pause before the second part, like he's steeling himself. Honest and worried.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ご飯はさらっと食べちゃいなさい
lines.en: Sho, just eat your meal without fussing, all right?
lines.style: Practical, fond correction. Light touch on the instruction. Not stern, but clear. The shorthand of a mother who knows her son will understand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今時のお父さんは料理上手だよ
lines.en: Mom, dads these days are actually pretty good at cooking.
lines.style: Observation offered with gentle pride. Thoughtful — he's noticed something about his father. Quiet conviction, not boasting. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達と遊ぶ時、騒ぐのも程々にね
lines.en: Sho, when you play with your friends, try not to get too loud, okay?
lines.style: Affectionate boundary-setting. Warm, not restrictive. The familiar tone of a recurring kindness. Slight lift at the end, checking he's with her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、絵本のページをめくって楽しんだよ
lines.en: Mom, I had fun turning the pages of the picture book.
lines.style: Genuine contentment in his voice. Simple happiness, no performance. Slow, savoring the memory. The way a child speaks when he's been truly present in something he loved.
